breast_fat_l.card: REFERENCE MODEL, NOT donor data: HuBMAP HRA 3D reference object `VH_F_mammary_gland_L` (v1.3, CC BY 4.0, Heidi Schlehlein), which the library describes as 'sculpted from scratch to include relevant anatomy for placement of registration blocks' with textbook atlases as the reference (Krstic 1994, Thieme Atlas of Anatomy 2008); it is placed in the Visible Human female's frame but was NOT built from her images. It is NOT part of Z-Anatomy (Z-Anatomy has no breast tissue: its skin only has a flat 'mammary region' patch), NOT measured by this atlas, and NOT a real breast of this page's body: this page's chest skin is nearly flat, whereas the library breast projects up to 40 mm farther forward. FITTED INTO THE SKIN ENVELOPE in two steps. (1) Registration: the HRA thoracic vertebrae onto the Z-Anatomy thoracic vertebrae T1-T12 of this page's body (rigid + uniform scale x0.9901, residual median 1.28 mm, p90 3.66). (2) Skin-envelope fit: each anteroposterior column of the breast (all breast structures with the same map) was compressed, only as much as needed, between this page's chest wall (Z-Anatomy ribs, costal cartilage, sternum, clavicle, scapula, pectoralis major and the other muscles, themselves fits to this page's skeleton) and this page's skin (median column ratio 0.89), then the rim that still overhung the skin or touched a muscle / bone was pushed in by a smooth field (2096 of 3901 vertices of this structure by more than 1 mm, max 39.4 mm). The shape is therefore the HRA breast flattened to the space this body leaves, not a measured breast. Shape: closed envelope of the HRA surface (voxel fill 0.8 mm, 7798 triangles after decimation (surface deviation from the full HRA mesh median 0.77, p95 1.58, max 2.94 mm)). Volume 344.7 cm3 after the fit (HRA original 717.71 cm3). Signed distances of every vertex: inside the skin by at least 1.04 mm (median 4.9 mm), pectoralis major 0.02 mm (positive = anterior to it), ribs / cartilage / sternum / clavicle / scapula at least 4.74 mm away. Distances to the Z-Anatomy muscles other than the pectoralis major are reported, not gated (they are fit estimates): 0.62 mm. Registration error: bone-based, median 1.28 mm; the fit error of the soft tissue is the compression itself (see volume). Q235 added the vestibular bulbs, Bartholin's glands, the perineal muscles, the perineal body, the female urethra (layers, lumen) as separate structures from ANOTHER person (Chinese Visible Human, CC BY 4.0; see their cards); the labia majora and minora, the mons pubis and the vulvar skin surface are not built. Hidden by default on Base · Female since Q292: replaced by her own CT breast (Q292); this HRA object is sculpted from scratch (HRA record), not donor data ('unhide' on the card). || Q299 containment fix: 1146 of 3901 vertices of this mesh lay OUTSIDE this page's own body (up to 23.8 mm in front of the nearest skin surface) and were pulled back in. Each such vertex was moved to the nearest point of this page's own skin / subcutaneous surface and 1.0 mm further in along the same line; the displacement was spread over the mesh with a 8 mm Gaussian, so 2468 vertices moved in all, by 6.8 mm on average and 24.5 mm at most. Nothing was sculpted and no vertex was invented: this is the skin guard of Q250 re-run against a body mask that passes validation (Q250's own guard could not decide inside from outside against ~250 open skin patches and recorded 1,057 such vertices as 'only counted'). Surface area x0.845, enclosed volume x0.616, 4 of 7798 triangles flipped, mean dihedral 17.4 -> 18.0 deg. Furthest point outside after the fix: 0.00 mm (the body mask's own error band is p95 1.4 / max 8.3 mm). THIS IS A LARGE SHAPE CHANGE: the structure lost more than a tenth of its enclosed volume, because the sculpted HuBMAP HRA breast object this page carries does not fit this page's chest skin. See docs/OPEN_ITEMS_FOR_OWNER.md: the alternatives are to re-run the Q250 chest-skin raise or to drop the HRA breast objects and keep only her own CT breast label (`breast_ct_l` / `breast_ct_r`, which is inside the body). Q353 chest_tuck: the part lying in or outside the skin moved inward along the skin's normal until it lies under the skin (under outer surface); rule-based, max 3.03 mm (cap 8), volume change 0.47 %; mesh, vertex and triangle counts unchanged. Q356 chest: the part lying in or outside the skin moved inward along the skin's normal until it lies under the skin (under outer surface); rule-based, max 1.76 mm (cap 8), volume change 0.0 %; mesh, vertex and triangle counts unchanged.
